mechanism.claim: The BTC response sign to corporate-credit polarity transitions can change across regimes. Learn that sign only from fully matured prior HYG-minus-LQD transition labels, including pre-high-volatility history, then causally follow or invert the current high-variation transition.
mechanism.side: current credit-transition sign multiplied by strict sign of the arithmetic mean of the latest at most 12 matured transition directional labels
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCQTR fixes the transition side and failed test; HVCQVAR routes by contemporaneous variation change and failed train. HVCQCA uses no source-state threshold beyond the current frozen variation gate and learns only from prior fully exited transition responses, without stage resets, future labels, costs, funding, equity, PnL, OI, premium, options, or promoted controls.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: high-variation credit transition times remain sparse and already passed Gross9 while adapted signs alter exposure

features.transition: strict polarity change in HYG-minus-LQD return versus immediately prior source-valid session
features.label_universe: all source-valid credit transitions regardless of BTC variation rank
features.label: transition side times log(BTC exit_open/entry_open) over 24 hours
features.memory: latest at most 12 matured transition labels; minimum 8
features.score: arithmetic mean gross log label, strict nonzero
features.routing: positive score keeps transition side; negative score inverts; insufficient/nonfinite/zero score is cash

clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after Gross9

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

research_boundary.classification: exploratory causal online adaptation; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: source causality, Gross9, train/test/eval/final; terminal first failure; no transition, label universe, memory, minimum labels, maturity, score, gate, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
